# Soance Innovations LLP

> Soance develops websites, web applications, mobile apps, custom software, automation and AI solutions for businesses.

Based in Kadirur, Kannur, Kerala, India, and serving customers in India and internationally. Business enquiries: info@soance.com; +91 8217445213. Canonical website: https://www.soance.com/.

The case-study library includes client projects and explicitly fictionalized scenarios. Fictional company identities and illustrative outcomes are not real customer evidence. Service-area pages describe places served, not separate offices. Refer to the linked pages for context.

# Creating an Accessible Digital Campus for Aarunova College

Source: https://www.soance.com/case-studies/aarunova-college-website.html

## Summary / TLDR

Aarunova College is a health sciences college offering degree programs, clinical training, and community education. The team needed a modern institutional website for admissions, departments, notices, accreditation, and student resources.

Soance shaped the strategy, experience, and technical foundation around measurable user and operational needs, then translated the concept into a launch-ready digital product.

## Overview

Aarunova College is a fictional higher education company created for this representative portfolio story. Its operating context, user needs, and delivery constraints are modeled on realistic digital transformation engagements.

The core brief was to deliver a modern institutional website for admissions, departments, notices, accreditation, and student resources while giving internal teams a system they could confidently operate, measure, and evolve after launch.

## Services provided

- Digital strategy and content architecture

- Responsive website design

- CMS implementation and migration

- Accessibility, technical SEO, performance, and security

## Challenges

The project needed to balance a polished customer experience with the less-visible realities of content, operations, permissions, integrations, and long-term maintainability.

- Program and department information architecture: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

- Admissions journeys and document downloads: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

- Notices, events, and governance publishing: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

## Solution

We clarified the story before designing a modular page system, then delivered a responsive CMS build with structured content, strong performance budgets, and measurable conversion paths.

- Designed and validated program and department information architecture as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

- Designed and validated admissions journeys and document downloads as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

- Designed and validated notices, events, and governance publishing as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

A shared design system, instrumentation plan, and staged release approach kept the product coherent while allowing the team to learn from realistic usage patterns.

## Illustrative outcomes

Because Aarunova College is fictional, these outcomes describe the intended value of the solution rather than claims about a real client engagement.

- A clearer proposition and more useful customer journeys

- Faster publishing with reusable page components

- Improved accessibility, performance, and search readiness

# Building a Trusted Digital Asset Marketplace for AlturaX

Source: https://www.soance.com/case-studies/alturax-asset-marketplace.html

## Summary / TLDR

AlturaX is a financial technology venture making private-market opportunities easier to discover and evaluate. The team needed a secure platform for listings, due diligence, investor onboarding, and controlled deal participation.

Soance shaped the strategy, experience, and technical foundation around measurable user and operational needs, then translated the concept into a launch-ready digital product.

## Overview

AlturaX is a fictional financial technology company created for this representative portfolio story. Its operating context, user needs, and delivery constraints are modeled on realistic digital transformation engagements.

The core brief was to deliver a secure platform for listings, due diligence, investor onboarding, and controlled deal participation while giving internal teams a system they could confidently operate, measure, and evolve after launch.

## Services provided

- Platform strategy and requirements definition

- User experience and interface design

- Full-stack application development

- Cloud architecture, security, analytics, and support

## Challenges

The project needed to balance a polished customer experience with the less-visible realities of content, operations, permissions, integrations, and long-term maintainability.

- Verified asset listings and document rooms: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

- Investor onboarding and suitability checks: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

- Permissioned workflows and audit trails: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

## Solution

We translated the operating model into a role-based platform, validated the highest-risk workflows early, and built a scalable web application with secure integrations and observable infrastructure.

- Designed and validated verified asset listings and document rooms as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

- Designed and validated investor onboarding and suitability checks as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

- Designed and validated permissioned workflows and audit trails as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

A shared design system, instrumentation plan, and staged release approach kept the product coherent while allowing the team to learn from realistic usage patterns.

## Illustrative outcomes

Because AlturaX is fictional, these outcomes describe the intended value of the solution rather than claims about a real client engagement.

- A single digital journey across previously fragmented tasks

- Better visibility for customers and operational teams

- A scalable architecture with clearer governance and support

# Turning Healthy Habits into Shared Challenges with Fitcentive

Source: https://www.soance.com/case-studies/fitcentive-wellness-rewards.html

## Summary / TLDR

Fitcentive is a wellness platform that turns progress into a shared experience. Members connect a wearable device, join group challenges, follow personalized health insights, and work toward rewards alongside friends and teammates.

The product brings physical health, mental well-being, accountability, and incentives into one focused mobile journey designed to make healthier habits easier to understand and sustain.

## Overview

Fitcentive approaches health as more than a step count. Its mobile experience combines group participation with real-time guidance across physical activity, mental well-being, cardiovascular fitness, and stress—then uses accountability and rewards to help turn short-term goals into repeatable habits.

## Product scope

- Group wellness challenges and team accountability

- Wearable-device connection and activity progress

- Personalized health insights and real-time tips

- Goal tracking, incentives, and reward experiences

- A focused acquisition journey leading into the mobile app

## Challenges

- Making wellness feel holistic: The experience needed to look beyond a single activity metric and represent physical and mental well-being together.

- Balancing individual and team progress: Personal health data had to remain understandable while contributing to a motivating group challenge.

- Turning data into action: Wearable signals and health information needed to become simple, timely guidance rather than another dense dashboard.

- Keeping incentives credible: Goals and rewards had to feel connected to meaningful progress and long-term habit formation.

- Explaining the product quickly: The public website needed to communicate the challenge, insight, and reward loop in a compact journey.

## Solution

The product is organized around a clear participation loop: connect, join, improve, and earn. Each stage gives members a visible next action while keeping individual progress connected to a wider community.

- Group challenges create shared goals and make accountability part of the experience.

- Wearable connectivity reduces manual tracking and keeps progress current.

- Personalized insights translate health signals into practical guidance.

- Progress and rewards provide clear milestones without separating motivation from wellness.

- The public experience uses direct product benefits and repeated download calls to action to shorten the path into the app.

## Results

Fitcentive presents a concise wellness proposition built around community, insight, and incentives rather than isolated activity tracking.

- One experience for joining challenges and following team progress

- Wearable-driven health information presented as understandable guidance

- Clear connections between daily goals, accountability, and rewards

- A product story that communicates the core value before app download

# Designing Two Enterprise Applications for Tata Technologies

Source: https://www.soance.com/case-studies/tata-technologies-app-design.html

## Summary / TLDR

Tata Technologies needed two enterprise applications designed in parallel around an early concept that was unusual for the Indian market. The work demanded a shared experience language, careful coordination, and many rounds of review before release.

The design process translated complex engineering and operational needs into clearer mobile workflows while maintaining consistency across both products.

## Overview

Tata Technologies is a global product engineering and digital services company serving automotive, industrial machinery, aerospace, and adjacent sectors. The application work sat within a broader mission to help manufacturers and their partners engineer, build, and operate better products.

## Services provided

- Product discovery and workflow mapping

- UX and interface design for two applications

- Interactive prototyping and shared component design

- Stakeholder review and iterative release support

- Website performance and Core Web Vitals optimization

## Challenges

- A new product concept: The original idea did not have an established local pattern to copy, so key interactions needed to be explored and validated.

- Two products at once: Parallel design work increased the need for shared decisions, reusable components, and coordinated delivery.

- Complex stakeholder feedback: Multiple iterations and releases were required before the final direction was ready.

- Performance expectations: The wider digital experience also needed measurable improvements to speed and Core Web Vitals.

## Solution

The team established a shared design language across both applications, then moved from high-priority workflows into interactive prototypes that made review and iteration concrete.

- Mapped users, tasks, approvals, and exception paths before visual design.

- Created reusable patterns so the applications felt related without forcing identical workflows.

- Used staged reviews and release cycles to resolve ambiguity early and steadily refine the experience.

- Addressed website performance through a focused Core Web Vitals audit and optimization work.

## Results

The engagement produced a more coherent experience across both applications and a practical system for carrying design decisions into future releases.

- A shared interface foundation across parallel products

- Clearer workflows for complex engineering and operational tasks

- Reduced design drift through reusable components and review checkpoints

- A reported 50% improvement in website speed and performance after Core Web Vitals work

- Designed and validated program and impact storytelling as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

- Designed and validated event registration and newsletter journeys as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

A shared design system, instrumentation plan, and staged release approach kept the product coherent while allowing the team to learn from realistic usage patterns.

## Illustrative outcomes

Because VerdurePath is fictional, these outcomes describe the intended value of the solution rather than claims about a real client engagement.

- More discoverable content and stronger topic authority

- A faster, more consistent editorial workflow

- Improved reading experience across mobile and desktop

# Creating a Connected Mobile Companion for Healthcare Professionals

Source: https://www.soance.com/case-studies/vissco-connect-health-companion.html

## Summary / TLDR

Vissco Connect is a mobile ecosystem created for healthcare professionals. It brings guided exercises, fitness assessments, yoga content, condition monitoring, articles, community features, templates, and order management into a single professional companion.

The work combined product design, application development, custom API integration, quality engineering, and sustained support so a broad feature set could remain coherent and dependable in everyday use.

## Overview

Developed with Vissco , an orthopedic and physiotherapy products company, Vissco Connect was designed to support doctors through a focused mobile experience. Beyond the initial build, the brief included ongoing optimization, policy compliance, and support across a changing device and dependency landscape.

## Services provided

- Mobile product and interface design

- Cross-platform application development

- Custom API and messaging integration

- Functional, compatibility, performance, and security testing

- App-store release support and ongoing maintenance

## Challenges

- Interconnected feature set: Exercises, assessments, content, profiles, community tools, and orders all depended on shared state and data.

- Complex API behavior: Custom filtering and search fields needed predictable client-side handling.

- Long-term maintainability: Package conflicts, discontinued dependencies, and growing code complexity had to be managed carefully.

- Device-specific behavior: Camera access caused crashes on some Vivo devices and required hardware-level investigation.

- Release compliance: The application had to keep pace with Play Store and App Store policy requirements.

## Solution

The application architecture used Redux-Saga to coordinate asynchronous work and shared state. Reusable, nested components kept the interface consistent while dedicated integration patterns handled custom API behavior.

- Separated feature responsibilities into reusable modules with clearer standards.

- Refined search, filter, notification, chat, referral, and task-management flows through iterative prototypes.

- Adjusted camera permissions and device handling to address manufacturer-specific crashes.

- Tested dependency combinations, devices, and release builds against store requirements.

- Introduced phased releases, monitoring, and user feedback loops for ongoing improvement.

## Results

Vissco Connect emerged as a more cohesive professional health platform, bringing previously separate tasks into one accessible mobile experience.

- Simpler navigation across clinical resources, activities, communication, and orders

- More consistent behavior across supported devices

- A reusable component foundation for future modules

- An ongoing support model for compatibility, policy, and performance updates

---

# Rebuilding Vissco’s Digital Product-Discovery Platform

Source: https://www.soance.com/case-studies/vissco-digital-revamp.html

## Summary / TLDR

Vissco needed to replace an aging website with a modern business and product-information platform. The new experience had to organize more than 1,000 orthopedic solutions and mobility aids while remaining understandable to customers with different needs and levels of product knowledge.

The revamp combined strategy, responsive design, WordPress development, content migration, quality assurance, and ongoing support into one maintainable product-discovery platform.

## Overview

Vissco manufactures orthopedic supports, mobility aids, and rehabilitation products. Its website needed to work as a comprehensive information and discovery destination—showing the range clearly, supporting research and educational content, and extending the brand beyond physical stores and traditional distribution.

## Services provided

- Digital strategy and experience design

- Responsive frontend and WordPress development

- Product taxonomy, content migration, and SEO continuity

- Cross-browser, functional, and usability testing

- Maintenance, security updates, and feature support

## Challenges

- A catalog of 1,000+ products: Categories, specifications, and use cases needed a structure that did not overwhelm visitors.

- CMS migration without search loss: Content had to move to a new system while protecting established SEO value.

- Broad audience needs: The same platform had to support consumers, caregivers, professionals, and international visitors.

- Education as well as discovery: Product pages needed to sit alongside useful resources that build understanding and confidence.

## Solution

The redesign began with navigation and user-flow strategy, then established a responsive visual system aligned with the healthcare brand. Product content was restructured around clearer categories and more informative detail pages.

- Created a scalable taxonomy and search-friendly product-page model.

- Migrated and optimized existing content with redirects and SEO continuity in mind.

- Added richer product information, educational resources, and clearer calls to action.

- Validated forms, browsing, and responsive behavior across devices and browsers.

- Established a maintenance rhythm for content, security, performance, and enhancements.

## Results

The redesigned platform gave Vissco a stronger digital storefront for product education and discovery, with a foundation that could continue to expand alongside the catalog.

- Wider access to product information beyond physical retail locations

- Clearer browsing across a large and technically varied catalog

- More useful educational content around orthopedic care and product selection

- A maintainable CMS that supports ongoing search, content, and feature work

# Helping Families Make Confident Financial Decisions with WealthOrbit

Source: https://www.soance.com/case-studies/wealthorbit-planning-platform.html

Soance shaped the strategy, experience, and technical foundation around measurable user and operational needs, then translated the concept into a launch-ready digital product.

## Overview

WealthOrbit is a fictional personal finance company created for this representative portfolio story. Its operating context, user needs, and delivery constraints are modeled on realistic digital transformation engagements.

The core brief was to deliver a guided digital journey for onboarding, goal planning, scenario comparison, and advisor collaboration while giving internal teams a system they could confidently operate, measure, and evolve after launch.

## Services provided

- Platform strategy and requirements definition

- User experience and interface design

- Full-stack application development

- Cloud architecture, security, analytics, and support

## Challenges

The project needed to balance a polished customer experience with the less-visible realities of content, operations, permissions, integrations, and long-term maintainability.

- Goal-based planning and scenario tools: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

- Secure document collection and task tracking: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

- Shared client and advisor workspaces: The experience needed to support this capability without adding unnecessary complexity for users or operational teams.

## Solution

We translated the operating model into a role-based platform, validated the highest-risk workflows early, and built a scalable web application with secure integrations and observable infrastructure.

- Designed and validated goal-based planning and scenario tools as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

- Designed and validated secure document collection and task tracking as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

- Designed and validated shared client and advisor workspaces as part of one coherent, role-aware product journey.

A shared design system, instrumentation plan, and staged release approach kept the product coherent while allowing the team to learn from realistic usage patterns.

# CubeSolv Privacy Policy

Source: https://www.soance.com/cubesolv-privacy.html

Last updated: July 22, 2026

CubeSolv works offline, does not require an account, and does not collect, sell, or share personal data.

## Information we collect

CubeSolv does not collect personal information, device identifiers, analytics, advertising data, or precise location.

## Camera and cube images

If you use Scan & Solve, CubeSolv accesses the camera only after you grant permission. Captured cube-face images are processed locally on your device to detect sticker colours. They are not uploaded or transmitted to us or any third party.

## Information stored on your device

Level progress, best move counts, and completion times are stored locally on your device. Removing the app may remove this local information, depending on your device settings.

## Sharing and third parties

CubeSolv does not share user data with third parties. The app contains no advertising SDK, analytics SDK, social login, or cloud account service.

## Children

CubeSolv is a general-audience puzzle app and is not designed primarily for children under 13. Because the app does not collect personal data, it does not knowingly collect personal information from children.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy if CubeSolv's features or data practices change. The latest version will show its effective date above.

## Contact

For privacy questions, contact support@soance.com .

When you purchase something from our store, as part of the buying and selling process, we collect the personal information you give us such as your name, address and email address.

When you browse our store, we also automatically receive your computer’s internet protocol (IP) address in order to provide us with information that helps us learn about your browser and operating system.

Email marketing (if applicable): With your permission, we may send you emails about our store, new products and other updates.

CONSENT

How do you get my consent?

When you provide us with personal information to complete a transaction, verify your credit card, place an order, arrange for a delivery or return a purchase, we imply that you consent to our collecting it and using it for that specific reason only.

If we ask for your personal information for a secondary reason, like marketing, we will either ask you directly for your expressed consent, or provide you with an opportunity to say no.

How do I withdraw my consent?

If after you opt-in, you change your mind, you may withdraw your consent for us to contact you, for the continued collection, use or disclosure of your information, at anytime, by contacting us at info@soance.com or mailing us at: I/478A,
                                    Pulliode, Kadirur,
                                    Kannur,
                                    Kerala,
                                    India - 670642

DISCLOSURE

We may disclose your personal information if we are required by law to do so or if you violate our Terms of Service.

PAYMENT

We use Razorpay for processing payments. We/Razorpay do not store your card data on their servers. The data is encrypted through the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) when processing payment. Your purchase transaction data is only used as long as is necessary to complete your purchase transaction. After that is complete, your purchase transaction information is not saved.

Our payment gateway adheres to the standards set by PCI-DSS as managed by the PCI Security Standards Council, which is a joint effort of brands like Visa, MasterCard, American Express and Discover.

PCI-DSS requirements help ensure the secure handling of credit card information by our store and its service providers.

For more insight, you may also want to read terms and conditions of razorpay on https://razorpay.com

THIRD-PARTY SERVICES

In general, the third-party providers used by us will only collect, use and disclose your information to the extent necessary to allow them to perform the services they provide to us.

However, certain third-party service providers, such as payment gateways and other payment transaction processors, have their own privacy policies in respect to the information we are required to provide to them for your purchase-related transactions.

For these providers, we recommend that you read their privacy policies so you can understand the manner in which your personal information will be handled by these providers.

# Refund Policy

Source: https://www.soance.com/refund-policy.html

Returns

Our policy lasts 30 days. If 30 days have gone by since your purchase, unfortunately we can’t offer you a refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused and in the same condition that you received it. It must also be in the original packaging.

Several types of goods are exempt from being returned. Perishable goods such as food, flowers, newspapers or magazines cannot be returned. We also do not accept products that are intimate or sanitary goods, hazardous materials, or flammable liquids or gases.

Additional non-returnable items:

- Gift cards

- Downloadable software products

- Some health and personal care items

To complete your return, we require a receipt or proof of purchase.

Please do not send your purchase back to the manufacturer.

There are certain situations where only partial refunds are granted: (if applicable)

Book with obvious signs of use

CD, DVD, VHS tape, software, video game, cassette tape, or vinyl record that has been opened.

Any item not in its original condition, is damaged or missing parts for reasons not due to our error.

Any item that is returned more than 30 days after delivery

Refunds (if applicable)

Once your return is received and inspected, we will send you an email to notify you that we have received your returned item. We will also notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.

If you are approved, then your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your credit card or original method of payment, within a certain amount of days.

Late or missing refunds (if applicable)

If you haven’t received a refund yet, first check your bank account again.

Then contact your credit card company, it may take some time before your refund is officially posted.

Next contact your bank. There is often some processing time before a refund is posted.

If you’ve done all of this and you still have not received your refund yet, please contact us at [___Company Contact Email___] .

Sale items (if applicable)

Only regular priced items may be refunded, unfortunately sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges (if applicable)

We only replace items if they are defective or damaged.  If you need to exchange it for the same item, send us an email at [___Company Contact Email___] and send your item to: 622 Manglam Electronic Market Jaipur Rajasthan India 302001.

Gifts

If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you.

If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and he will find out about your return.

Shipping

To return your product, you should mail your product to: 622 Manglam Electronic Market Jaipur Rajasthan India 302001.

You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.

Depending on where you live, the time it may take for your exchanged product to reach you, may vary.

If you are shipping an item over $75, you should consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item.
